lessons_used: Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +3.1%), but can also severely backfire (-8.9%), with positive impacts often overestimated.
Account safety copy changes during sign-in were helpful (+3.5%), whereas general intro copy updates showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns and guides carry high risk, hurting performance far worse than predicted (-10.1% vs -1.0%), while other redesigns showed no clear effect.
Notifications, waiting screens, hints, and checklist layout changes showed no clear effect, making positive predictions (+0.5% to +5.0%) consistently too high.

candidates.title: Preset Pet Archetype Selection Gallery
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a structured grid layout featuring clear pet personality archetypes and companion preview cards.
candidates.why: The adoption step has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and a median time of 89s, indicating drop-off and friction during companion selection.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet archetype to join you on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend to a grid layout with choice cards maintains its core function of letting the user select a pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption loses 39.1% of users, but redesigns carry high risk and previously dropped adoption conversion by -4.1%.

candidates.title: Move Sign-In Screen to Final Onboarding Step
candidates.change: Move the sign_in step to occur right after waiting and before the final home_intro screen.
candidates.why: Moving sign-in after users have already chosen and customized their pet reduces early drop-off and helps link their newly created pet directly to their account.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in to occur after waiting is explicitly permitted under base rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign_in yielded +1.5% over past tests, but flow reordering carries a risk of backfiring.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Render Diagnostic Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new verification screen after waiting to confirm screen overlay permissions and pet desktop rendering before finishing.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing up on the desktop or app failing to open, and waiting step mean time is over 2300s.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Rendering
waiting.body: We are preparing your pet to appear on your screen overlay.

candidates.change: Redesign home_intro screen into a spotlight layout emphasizing key desktop pet control toggles.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets from users confused about how to control or hide their pet, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Controlling Your Desktop Pet
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick controls, hide, or interact.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a badge cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Recovery Sign-In Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in safeguards and restores their existing pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing pets or resets after re-authenticating, and past findings show account safety copy during sign-in improves conversion (+3.5%).

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pets
sign_in.body: Logging in keeps your adopted companions safely saved to your account so you never lose them.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to explain account backup does not violate any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Supported by both funnel data and 8 support emails; sign-in account safety copy previously achieved +3.5% lift.

candidates.title: Guided Pet Style Customization Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a two-step companion customization sequence (new_pet_style and new_pet_details) before photo uploads.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, while adoption step completion rate is low at 60.9%.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_pet_style', 'new_pet_details']

candidates.change: Add an explicit explanatory hint beneath the path selection screen clarifying the difference between quick preset and custom creation paths.
candidates.why: 21.7% of users drop off at choose_path with a high mean time of 514s, indicating uncertainty when deciding between onboarding paths.

choose_path.hint: Choose Preset for an instant ready-to-use pet, or Custom to create a unique companion from your photos.

candidates.change: Change adoption_certificate layout to 'stage' to create a focused celebration moment before desktop asset rendering.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (60.9%) and long completion times.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your companion is officially registered and ready to move to your desktop.

guard.reason: Updating the adoption certificate layout while retaining its core function is permitted under base rules 2 and 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (39.1%), but layout modifications have negative historical results (-5.6%) and high risk.

candidates.change: Update the home_intro headline and primary call-to-action button label to explicitly prompt releasing the pet onto the desktop.
candidates.why: The finish step has a drop-off rate of 35.2% (64.8% conversion) and median duration of 395s, showing hesitation at the final step.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready to Meet You!

guard.reason: Updating copy on home_intro buttons and headlines is fully permitted within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 35.2% of users, but general CTA/intro copy updates showed no clear effect in lessons.

candidates.title: Asset Generation Progress & Time Indicator
candidates.change: Enable progress bar and estimated time indicators on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high median time (201s) and mean time (2336s), causing user impatience and drop-off without visual feedback.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Please wait while we render and place your pet on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding progress and estimated time indicators to the waiting screen for a real wait is permitted under base rules 4 and 5.

candidates.score_note: Targeting 201s median wait time, but wait screen info changes previously produced minimal gains (+0.3%).

picked: Move Sign-In Screen to Final Onboarding Step

decisions.title: Move Sign-In Screen to Final Onboarding Step

lessons_next: Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +3.1%), but can also severely backfire (-8.9%) or show no clear effect, with positive predictions often being too high.

Copy changes focused on account persistence safety (+3.5%) and launch call-to-actions (+6.7%) were helpful; launch button predictions were too low (+6.7% measured vs +0.5% predicted), while general intro copy showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns and interactive guides carry severe risk, hurting performance far worse than predicted (-10.1%, -19.3%), while others showed no clear effect.
Notifications, hints, waiting screens, and checklist layout changes showed no clear effect across all tested rounds.
